items:
Discounts are automatically applied to stays, no promo codes needed. The total price already includes your savings.

Each reservation of this property includes a credit to be used towards beach gear rentals and services at La Dolce Vita! This includes bikes, paddle boards, kayaks, tours/experiences, and could even be used towards a beach bonfire for the entire family!



Welcome to Grace Villa, the perfect family vacation home!



Located in the beautiful Seagrove Beach, and nestled back in the Summers Edge Community, this spacious home is perfect for large families or large groups. You have access to not one but TWO community pools, one of which is seasonally heated! Grace Villa is also conveniently located right next to the community beach access, making the stroll to the beach just a few steps!



As you enter the home you will notice the open-concept living, dining, and kitchen area. You'll be sure to enjoy the 55” Flat Screen T.V. on the cozy sectional sofa in the living room. Whether you are cooking, dining, or relaxing on the couch, everyone is sure to feel together with this floor plan! There is a large master suite with a private bathroom located on this level as well. Perfect for the family member who may prefer not to take the stairs!



As you make your way to the second floor you will notice another sitting area for watching tv or playing games! This level also includes 2x Queen suites, each with its own Large Bath and adjoining bunk room to keep the kids close but not too close. There is a balcony on this level for enjoying a morning cup of coffee while making plans for a relaxing beach day.



The third floor of the home includes another complete bedroom with a King Bed and a Large Bath. It too has access to the third-floor balcony and includes a chaise lounge and Flat Screen TV with Cable.



Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps (16)

1st Floor:

- Master Suite-King Bed and Private Bath - Walk-in Shower/ Tub



Second Floor:

Bedroom II-Queen Bed - Private Bath with Tub/Shower Combo

Bedroom III-Queen Bed - Private Bath with Tub/ Shower Combo

- 2 Bunk Rooms with 2 Twin Beds in Each

-2 Sleeper Sofas



Third Floor:

-King Bed - Private Bath with Tub and Walk in Shower



Amenities:

- 50 Yards to Beach Access

- 55" Flat Screen TV in Living Room

- Master Suite and Kitchen on 1st Level

- Two Community Pools / 1x Heated

- Stainless Kitchen Appliances

- Washer / Dryer



SUGGESTED ITEMS TO BRING Beach towels, beach chairs, sunscreen, sunglasses, bug spray, paper towels, toilet paper, trash bags, dishwasher detergent, laundry soap, bath soap, bicycles, rafts, coffee filters, antiseptic, flashlights, and beach toys.



Starter Amenity Package:



All guests are provided with an "amenity starter kit," which includes an initial supply of bath soap, shampoo, conditioner, shower gel, dishwasher pods ( x1) toilet paper, paper towels, hand soap, laundry pods (X1), and trash bags. These items are provided for your convenience, and are only intended to get you through your first 24-48 hours of your stay.





FAQ:

Type of coffee pot: K cup or standard coffee pot

Parking spots: MAX 1 vehicle in the driveway.

Distance to beach: 50 yards the beach

Bikes included: no (can use rental credit towards bikes.)

Beach Chairs & Umbrella set-up included: No

Community Pool heated: 2 pools, one is heated



Make Grace Villa your next family vacation destination and it will become your family tradition for years to come.

SUGGESTED ITEMS TO BRING Beach towels, beach chairs, sunscreen, sunglasses, bug spray, paper towels, toilet paper, trash bags, dishwasher detergent, laundry soap, bath soap, bicycles, rafts, coffee filters, antiseptic, flashlights, and beach toys.

description: Located by the ocean, this vacation home is in Seagrove Beach, a neighborhood in Santa Rosa Beach. The area's natural beauty can be seen at Grayton Beach State Park and Seaside Beach. Sundog Books and Eden Gardens State Park are also worth visiting. Snorkeling, sailing, and surfing/body boarding offer great chances to get out on the surrounding water, or you can seek out an adventure with cycling nearby.
